parent_objective: synthesize the paper-route causal-history evidence branch and select the next research branch
blocked_by: M1223 routes to synthesis after M1222 finds action gaps without outcome gaps
supersedes: continuing current-family causal-history source mining without branch synthesis
invalidates: treating the causal-history branch as solved by action divergence alone

public_gates: M1224 may synthesize M1215-M1223 evidence only
M1224 must answer the required synthesis questions
M1224 must select one next branch or stop the branch
M1224 must not run new source mining or outcome intervention
M1224 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim history necessity from action-only evidence
do not leave the next branch vague

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes current-family causal-history evidence into a next-branch decision
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process synthesis only; no closed-loop proof, training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if synthesis upgrades action gaps into self-ID evidence
stop if M1218/M1220/M1222 negative evidence is omitted
stop if no next branch decision is made
fallback_plan: route to terminal-boundary materialization if current-family action gaps are enough to justify boundary sharpening
route to stronger cross-family/fault source if current-family scenes are outcome-insensitive
stop current-family causal-history source mining if no high-leverage next step remains
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1223 classifies M1222 as action-gap-positive outcome-gap-negative after eight causal-history milestones

admission_evidence: M1218 wrong/delayed matched-history action screen is negative
M1220 hidden path is positive but real histories remain action-equivalent
M1222 broader source mining finds action gaps but no outcome gaps
M1223 selects synthesis before another narrow run
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: supported and blocked claims are listed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1224 must preserve the distinction between hidden-path sensitivity, action divergence, and outcome-level history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Outcome-level history necessity remains blocked unless a later branch produces margin or success degradation under real history interventions.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Preserve negative action-screen and outcome-gap evidence as constraints on the next branch.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The current-family causal-history branch has enough evidence to synthesize supported and blocked claims and select a higher-leverage next branch.
success_criteria: supported claims and blocked claims are separated
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs

commands.name: synthesize_causal_history_evidence
commands.command: synthesize M1215-M1223 causal-history evidence without training

decision_rule: M1224 passes if it makes a concrete next-branch decision without claim expansion.
